title: Checkbox group
summary: Any number of values chosen with a set of checkboxes; the group owns the value list, the name and an optional parent checkbox.

examples.label: A parent checkbox over the set
examples.subject: component:checkbox-group
examples.markup: <ui-field label="Notify by"><ui-checkbox-group name="channels" value="email"><ui-checkbox parent>All channels</ui-checkbox><ui-checkbox value="email">Email</ui-checkbox><ui-checkbox value="push">Push</ui-checkbox><ui-checkbox value="sms">SMS</ui-checkbox></ui-checkbox-group></ui-field>
